title: Create subscription with USD currency
description: Create a new subscription for a customer using USD as the billing currency and verify that the initial invoice amount matches the product price in USD.
preconditions: Product with price $10.00 USD exists; customer account is active.
postconditions: Subscription remains active; invoice recorded in the system.
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to the subscription creation page."
2. "Select the customer."
3. "Choose the product priced in USD."
4. "Set the billing currency to USD."
5. "Submit the subscription request."
steps_result:
1. "System accepts the subscription request."
2. "Subscription is created with status Active."
3. "An invoice is generated in USD."
4. "Invoice amount equals the product price (e.g., $10.00)."
5. "Customer receives a confirmation email with invoice details."

title: Change subscription currency from USD to EUR
description: Change an existing active subscription from USD to EUR and verify that the system recalculates the next invoice amount using the current exchange rate.
preconditions: Active subscription in USD exists; valid EUR exchange rate is configured.
postconditions: Subscription continues with EUR billing; next invoice scheduled.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the subscription details page for the active USD subscription."
2. "Select Change Billing Currency option."
3. "Choose EUR from the currency dropdown."
4. "Confirm the currency change."
5. "Review the displayed next invoice amount."
steps_result:
1. "System allows currency change request."
2. "Subscription currency is updated to EUR."
3. "Next invoice amount is recalculated based on USD→EUR exchange rate."
4. "Invoice amount reflects the prorated EUR value."
5. "Customer receives notification of the currency change and new invoice amount."

title: Reject subscription creation with unsupported currency
description: Attempt to create a subscription using an unsupported currency code (XYZ) and verify that the system rejects the request with an appropriate error message.
preconditions: Product exists; customer account is active.
postconditions: System state unchanged; no new records.
steps_actions:
1. "Navigate to the subscription creation page."
2. "Select the customer."
3. "Choose a product."
4. "Set the billing currency to XYZ (unsupported)."
5. "Submit the subscription request."
steps_result:
1. "System validates the selected currency."
2. "Currency XYZ is identified as unsupported."
3. "Subscription creation is blocked."
4. "Error message Unsupported currency is displayed to the user."
5. "No subscription or invoice is created in the system."

title: Validate rejection of negative exchange rate entry
description: Enter an invalid exchange rate (negative value) for EUR and verify that the system prevents saving the rate and shows a validation error.
preconditions: Admin user is logged in; exchange rate management feature is accessible.
postconditions: Existing valid exchange rates remain unchanged.
steps_actions:
1. "Log in as an admin user."
2. "Navigate to the Exchange Rates management page."
3. "Select EUR from the currency list."
4. "Enter -0.85 as the exchange rate."
5. "Attempt to save the exchange rate."
steps_result:
1. "System opens the exchange rate configuration screen."
2. "User inputs a negative exchange rate for EUR."
3. "Validation detects the negative value."
4. "Error message Exchange rate must be a positive number is displayed."
5. "Exchange rate is not saved."

title: Handle system failure during multi-currency billing run
description: Simulate a system crash during the billing run for a multi-currency subscription and verify that no duplicate invoices are generated and the transaction is rolled back.
preconditions: Active subscription with EUR billing exists; exchange rate is configured.
postconditions: Subscription remains in pre-billing state; no duplicate invoices exist.
steps_actions:
1. "Trigger the scheduled billing job for the day."
2. "Inject a failure (e.g., kill the billing service process) after the invoice record is created but before commit."
3. "Restart the billing service."
4. "Inspect the invoice table for entries related to the subscription."
5. "Check system logs for error handling and retry scheduling."
steps_result:
1. "Billing process starts and locks the subscription record."
2. "System crash occurs before invoice commit."
3. "Upon restart, the billing job detects incomplete transaction."
4. "No invoice is persisted for the failed run."
5. "System logs the failure and schedules a retry without double-charging the customer."
